title: Paired-face horn filtration for the fixed-source twisted-arrow simplex
statement:
Use standard simplices and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $n\geq1$ and $V_n=\{0,1,\ldots,2n+1\}$ with its usual order. For a nonempty $S\subseteq V_n$, let $\Delta^S$ be the face of $\Delta^{2n+1}$ spanned by $S$. Say that $S$ is basic if $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n\}$ or $S\cap\{i,2n+1-i\}=\varnothing$ for some $0\leq i\leq n$. Let $K_0$ be the union of all basic faces. For a nonbasic $S$, define
$$\operatorname{pr}(S)=\max\{i\in\{0,\ldots,n\}:2n+1-i\in S\};$$
this maximum exists because $S$ is not contained in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. Call $S$ prioritized if $\operatorname{pr}(S)\in S$. Enumerate all prioritized nonbasic subsets as $S_1,\ldots,S_m$, in nondecreasing priority and, among those of equal priority, in nondecreasing cardinality; ties may be ordered arbitrarily. Put $K_q=K_0\cup\bigcup_{a=1}^q\Delta^{S_a}$. For every $1\leq q\leq m$, write $S_q=\{j_0<\cdots<j_d\}$ and $\operatorname{pr}(S_q)=j_k$. Under the vertex-order identification $\Delta^{S_q}\cong\Delta^d$, one has
$$\Delta^{S_q}\cap K_{q-1}=\Lambda_k^d.$$
Moreover, $S_m=V_n$ and $K_m=\Delta^{2n+1}$.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 8.1.2.1, basic subsets, priority ordering, and the assertion that each attaching intersection is the horn $\Lambda^d_k$.
